title: Update on Binance Futures NEXT Services
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, As Binance conducts regular reviews of its product offerings to focus on products that can provide users with the most value and competitive services, Binance Futures will gradually cease support for Futures NEXT over the next two weeks.  Timeline for the Gradual Cessation of Support Nominations   and Adding Picks : From  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC) , users will no longer be able to nominate new tokens nor add new picks to any nominated tokens. Rewards Distribution:  No new rewards will be distributed after  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC) . Rewards from any listed nominated tokens on Futures NEXT prior to  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC)  will still be distributed. Withdrawals and Refunds of Picks:  Users can choose to withdraw their picks back to their USDⓈ-M account at any time. However, re-allocating picks from one token to another nominated token will no longer be supported from  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC) . All remaining user picks will be refunded to their respective USDⓈ-M Futures accounts on  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC) . Please note that the Futures NEXT page will no longer be accessible from  2025-05-30 08:00 (UTC). For more information on how to withdraw your picks back to your USDⓈ-M account, please refer to this FAQ:  Introducing Futures NEXT: Predict Token Listings and Earn on USDⓈ-M Futures Market . Thank you for your support and interest in Futures NEXT. We remain committed to delivering innovative and valuable products to all our users. Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
